title: Module inventory
description: What runs on a site, by kind, for the module loader's two-way check (ADR-0027, proposed; docs/modules.md, 'What the loader checks'): every running name bound to a module id (<id> or <id>-..., a table as table:<id_>.<name>) must be declared by that module, which the site selects, and every declared name must run. A name bound to no module id is the core's and is not judged by this check. Every kind is listed, even when empty (a missing list would read as 'nothing runs'), unless not_gathered names it: then it is left out and the loader notes it as not compared. hnx modules gather builds one from the census the module_census role takes on the hosts: units (every hnx-<name>.service or .timer some host reports enabled, as <name>), with service rows, MCP servers, agents and tables, which the hosts do not report, named in not_gathered, and notify_pairs from the pairs records the notifier owners write (left out when no host holds one). Optionally, the running notifier's recovery pairs (notify_pairs), each with the module it is bound to; a pair with no module must be one of the core's own (homelabnext.notify.core_pairs). Without notify_pairs the pairs are not compared, and the loader says so. Optionally, listening: the sockets each host listens on, by which each selected module's service row is judged (derived from the placement and the row's port). The rules are in homelabnext.modules.loader.running_problems.

units.description: Fleet unit names that are installed and enabled.

rows.description: Service rows that answer: a feature's or core module's by row name, a provider's by the instance the site names.

mcp_servers.description: MCP server ids that are registered.

agents.description: Agent keys that have a compiled profile and a lane.

not_gathered.description: Kinds this inventory does not report (a gathered one: the hosts do not report them): each is left out of the inventory and noted as not compared, never read as 'nothing runs'. A kind it names must not be listed.

problem.description: The problem title the notifier holds.

module.description: The module the pair was loaded from; absent for a pair of the core's.

notify_pairs.description: The running notifier's recovery pairs (optional): each declared by its module, which the site selects, with the same recovery title, and every selected module's pair running.

sockets.description: Each TCP port the host listens on and UDP port it has bound, as proto/port.

listening.description: Optionally, the sockets each host listens on, from the kernel's socket tables (hnx modules gather). With it, hnx modules check judges each selected module's service row by whether the host the site places it on (the site host of that name, or whose name is the census host's first label) listens on the row's port: derived, so a port held by another program reads as answering and an undeclared row is never seen. Rows themselves stay in not_gathered.
